explanation: Bed (headboard), Beer (foam head), Hammer (striking head), and Nail (top part) all refer to a physical component or feature called a 'head'. A 'Letterhead' refers to the pre-printed design at the top of stationery, not a literal physical 'head' on the letter itself.
Hamlet, Othello, King Lear, and Macbeth are all considered among William Shakespeare's greatest tragedies. 'A Midsummer Night's Dream' is one of his most famous comedies.
Mile, Kilometer, Yard, and Foot are all standard units for measuring linear length or distance. Acre is a unit specifically used for measuring area.
